name: Leon
source:
Cruel, domineering, and hedonistic, he views female servants, especially humans, as less than bags of meat to derive pleasure from. He is quick to dismiss Kurumi, declaring her to be useless if he cannot sleep with her. Once learning that she is submissive to his advances, he forces her into servitude as a maid, although he makes it clear that she is to serve him in other ways as well.

[Taken from eroderekko]
